name: VastGaussian
definition: A large-scale method that partitions the scene into spatially-disjoint regions, trains per region with decoupled appearance handling for varying lighting, and merges with feathered overlap.
summary: VastGaussian is a large-scale 3D Gaussian Splatting method that partitions scenes into disjoint regions for scalable training, distinguished by decoupled appearance handling and feathered overlap merging.
